name: cis,cis-muconate
design_difference: cis,cis-muconate with product-specific cofactor and precursor accounting
request: 在 E. coli K-12 MG1655/iJO1366 中，从唯一碳源葡萄糖设计通向 cis,cis-muconate 的反应和酶组合。中心前体DHS或chorismate由宿主从葡萄糖合成，不能作为额外碳源摄取。使用公开反应选项，输出有向连接的steps及空gene_knockouts。保持葡萄糖摄取10 mmol/gDW/h、原公开培养基及野生型最大生长20%的下限；理论产率至少0.64220424 mol/mol，支路不超过4步，异源基因及必需支持角色不超过3个。考虑前体、辅因子、副产物与工程复杂度。公开酶的跨文献组合是待评价的新计算设计，不等于原文献生产菌株；模型产率不是实测滴度。

computational_conditions.units: Flux mmol/gDW/hour; growth 1/hour. Defined computational medium, not a reconstructed historical broth.

catalytic_support_assumptions: Active DHS dehydratase; original clone-specific metal requirement unresolved
Native E. coli UbiX support assumed available; no fixed per-product cofactor turnover assigned

expected_output.artifact: ordered reaction/enzyme option IDs and gene knockouts, expanded to balanced sourced reactions

provenance.case_scope: Original QH4 glycerol/glucose/yeast-extract condition differs; this explicitly uses glucose-only iJO1366 with declared reference enzymes.

instructions: 根据自然语言目标自主设计，选择工具与迭代策略。
使用公开资源；不得搜索历史答案。输出完整设计，计算分数不等同于湿实验读出。
候选包含 id、parent_id、design、rationale。设计字段遵循 scientific-profile.json 的 decision_schema。

evaluation_contract.threshold_basis: Before formal LLM: yield >=95% of the best feasible curated route under the original case step/gene caps, determined by exhaustive library enumeration; no LLM outcomes used. Numerical equivalence tolerance 1e-7; shortest route, then fewer genes, then lexical IDs break ties. Model-relative computational target, not measured production.
